steps.en: Start the server once on the machine your agent can reach
steps.zh: 在 agent 够得着的机器上把服务启动一次

steps.en: Fetches the Camoufox browser (~300MB) once, then listens on port 9377 and stays idle
steps.zh: 下载一次 Camoufox（约 300MB），随后监听 9377 端口待命

steps.en: Your agent opens a tab with a user id and a URL
steps.zh: 你的 agent 带上用户标识和网址开一个标签页

steps.en: Launches the fingerprint-spoofed Firefox on demand and loads the page in that user's own session
steps.zh: 按需拉起伪装过指纹的 Firefox，在该用户独立的会话里打开页面

steps.en: Your agent asks what is on the page
steps.zh: 你的 agent 问页面上有什么

steps.en: Returns a compact text outline of the page with numbered elements (e1, e2, …)
steps.zh: 返回一份精简的页面文字提纲，可操作元素带编号（e1、e2……）

steps.en: Your agent clicks or types by element number, then snapshots again
steps.zh: 你的 agent 按编号点击或输入，再取一次快照

value.en: Your agent reads and operates sites that block stock Playwright, without you wiring a stealth browser or parsing raw HTML
value.zh: agent 能读、能操作那些拦普通 Playwright 的网站，你不用自己接反检测浏览器，也不用解析原始 HTML

sources: README.md Quick Start > Standalone (`npx @askjo/camofox-browser`; `npm start  # downloads Camoufox on first run (~300MB)`; default port 9377)
README.md API tables (`POST /tabs`, `GET /tabs/:id/snapshot`, `POST /tabs/:id/click`) and Usage > Basic Browsing (userId/sessionKey/url body, snapshot with element refs e1/e2, click by ref)
README.md Features + Architecture (lazy browser launch and idle shutdown; one BrowserContext per user with isolated cookies/storage)
lib/camoufox-download.js (camoufox-js CamoufoxFetcher downloads the pinned Camoufox release) and mcp/README.md Workflow (snapshot before you act)
